take: Seattle announced it has placed center Jake O'Brien and right wing Mackie Samoskevich on injured reserve. The site has no numbers on O'Brien. Samoskevich has three goals and an assist in eight games, though that is 1.65 goals above what his shot quality (expected goals) predicted, so some of it may not last. Seattle's second-line forward, he averaged 15:23 a night and worked the second power-play unit. Based on how the coach has used his players, Berkly Catton (14:27 a night) is next in line for those minutes.
